tool_input.description: Print h2 elements from both snapshots

result:
I wrote the test, and it passes on the before snapshot and fails on the after snapshot. It finds the `h2` inside each of `section#programs`, `#faculty` and `#research`, and checks that its computed `color` is `rgb(34, 34, 34)`, the before page's `#222`. On the after snapshot all three fail: each one names the heading's selector and shows the actual color, `rgb(30, 64, 175)`.

There is a conflict in this case. The design intent says turning these headings dark blue was on purpose, so the three flagged boxes are really the intended change, and this test asserts against it. I kept it because they are the only flagged elements, and the test has to fail on the after page. The diff has one change the design intent doesn't mention: the footer line "Contact us at: info@educationalinstitute.com" went from white to `#1e40af`, dark blue on the `#3b82f6` blue footer. That is likely the real regression, but the detector didn't flag it, so the test doesn't check it.
